From the owner
“I do not want to get to the end of my life and find that I just lived the length of it. I want to have lived the width of it as well.” — Diane Ackerman We think there’s something to that in remodeling, too. Sometimes the right answer is timeless and quiet. Sometimes it’s green cabinets, a bold tile or wallpaper that makes a statement. One of the things we love most about what we do? We don’t have to stay in one design lane. Every homeowner and every home is different, and we get to help bring that personality to life, one design at a time.

LIFE-CHANGING REMODELING

McDonald Remodeling celebrates design down to the last detail. Details make or break a good design and challenging design is our specialty. We relish the chance to dig into our rich knowledge base to come up with a creative and finely crafted transformation for your home.

ABOUT US

McDonald Remodeling is a full-service residential design/build firm serving Minneapolis, St. Paul, and Twin Cities suburbs since 2000 — offering remodeling of spaces throughout the home, including kitchens, bathrooms, lower levels, whole-home renovations, outdoor living and more.

FEATURED PROJECTS

You choose the space and we’ll help dream up your ideal renovation and then execute the plan to make it a reality.

A NAVY NOVELTY
COMFORTABLY COMPOSED
RUSTIC CHARM, SPEAKEASY STYLE
90S MAIN LEVEL REMODEL
LAKESIDE HAVEN
MCM MINNEAPOLIS REMODEL

WHAT CLIENTS ARE SAYING

Design Phase Testimonial

The design staff, project manager, and specialists were humble and hardworking, responding promptly to concerns and respecting our home. Having waited so long for a new kitchen I knew that high level craftsmanship was a necessary ingredient in creating a beautiful kitchen. I’m so glad we chose a remodeler that values relationships with clients and has both vision and expertise. McDonald Remodeling exceeded our expectations.

- Kathy | Prior Lake, MN

 

Jim gave me a lot of his time and patience. His wealth of knowledge eased a lot of my worries. I should have done this project from the start two years ago. The ability to feel safe in your home speaks volumes. Having a daughter/toddler with medical complexities and a wheelchair is hard so having a home without obstacles makes our lives better. The design work and functionality are outstanding.

- Shawn & Tram | Minneapolis, MN

 

It was a ‘one-stop shop’ from start to finish. The design and creativity were top-notch. The ease of the whole project was outstanding. We are very happy, very impressed and very satisfied with the results. McDonald Remodeling was great to work with, and they finished on time and within budget. We highly recommend them.

Bill & Jane | Inver Grove Heights, MN

SEE MORE REVIEWS
AWARD-WINNING

We are one of the most awarded home remodelers in Minneapolis & St. Paul and the Twin Cities. Please take some time to view some of the great projects we’ve been able to accomplish with our fantastic clients, or check out the full list of our awards.

LATEST NEWS & EVENTS
Recrafted Heritage Kitchen & Main Floor Remodel

A 100+ year-old St. Paul home, thoughtfully reworked for modern living. This kitchen and main floor remodel preserves historic character while opening up the layout for better flow, function, and connection. See the full before and after transformation.

Read more →
Get to Know the Designer: Alisa Dragt-Hoffman

Alisa Dragt-Hoffman owns 32 globes, has a soft spot for warm colors and natural materials, and isn't afraid to tell you when a design choice isn't quite right. She also knows there's a lot more to a great remodel than picking pretty things. We caught up with Alisa to talk about what homeowners tend to overthink, why lighting deserves more attention and what really goes on behind the scenes of a remodel.

Read more →

Still have questions? Take a look at our FAQs page or reach out anytime. We’re happy to start a conversation and address any questions you have.
